# Shenzhen Hua Yi Teng Technology Co., Ltd. (Hua Yi Teng / 华亿腾)

> Shenzhen Hua Yi Teng Technology Co., Ltd. (HYT, established in 2008) is an ISO 9001:2015 certified B2B manufacturer specializing in high-reliability AC/DC power adapters, interchangeable-plug wall chargers, desktop power supplies, USB/Type-C fast chargers, and IP44 outdoor rainproof/splashproof power supplies up to 180W.

## About the Company
- **Full Legal Name**: Shenzhen Hua Yi Teng Technology Co., Ltd. / 深圳市华亿腾科技开发有限公司
- **Founded**: 2008
- **Headquarters & Factory**: 2/F, No. 3, E'gongling, Liulian Community, Pingdi Subdistrict, Longgang District, Shenzhen, Guangdong, China
- **Telephone**: +86-755-84099039
- **Official Website**: https://hyteng.com/
- **Alibaba Verified Store**: https://hyteng.en.alibaba.com/
- **Quality Management System**: ISO 9001:2015 Certified Factory
- **Manufacturing Capacity**: Over 900,000 units monthly across multiple automated SMT and assembly lines.

## Core Product Lines (1W – 180W)
1. **Wall-Mount / Plug-in Power Adapters (3W – 72W)**: Fixed-pin compact AC adapters for US, EU, UK, AU, JP, KR, and CN sockets; Level VI / DoE VI / CoC Tier 2 energy efficiency.
2. **Desktop Power Adapters (12W – 180W)**: High-power external adapters with C6, C8, and C14 AC inlets; Class I and Class II grounding options.
3. **Interchangeable-Plug Adapters (5W – 65W)**: Universal travel and global retail adapters with detachable US/EU/UK/AU/JP/KR AC pins.
4. **IP44 Waterproof / Rainproof Adapters (3W – 60W)**: Splashproof AC/DC power supplies for holiday lighting, garden decor, outdoor landscape fixtures, and fountain pumps.
5. **USB & USB-C GaN Fast Chargers (10W – 100W)**: Single and multi-port Type-C PD 3.0, QC 4.0+, and GaN chargers for consumer electronics and mobile devices.

## OEM & ODM Customization Capabilities
- **Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)**: Starts from 100 pcs for standard models; low-barrier sample testing available for B2B buyers.
- **Sample Lead Time**: 3–5 calendar days for standard specifications; 5–10 calendar days for customized samples.
- **Bulk Production Lead Time**: 15–20 calendar days for standard models; 20–30 calendar days for custom runs.
- **Electrical Customization**: Tailored output voltage (3V–48V DC), current (up to 15A), tight ripple & noise control, over-voltage (OVP), over-current (OCP), and short-circuit (SCP) protections.
- **Mechanical Customization**: DC connector types (5.5x2.1mm, 5.5x2.5mm, Type-C, Micro-USB, waterproof IP44 connectors, custom terminal blocks), cable lengths, customized housing molds, and fire-retardant (UL94-V0) polycarbonate plastics.
- **Branding & Packaging**: Custom silk-screen logo, laser engraving, safety compliance ratings label, barcode stickers, individual kraft or full-color gift box packaging.
- **Quality Control**: 100% full-load aging/burn-in testing before shipment, ATE automatic test verification, hi-pot insulation testing, drop test, and full batch traceability.
- **Warranty**: 2-year manufacturer warranty across standard power adapter series.

## Global Certifications & Compliance
- **North America**: UL / ETL (UL 62368-1, UL 1310 Class 2), FCC Part 15B, ICES-003.
- **European Union**: CE (LVD & EMC), GS (TÜV / Intertek), RoHS 2.0 (2011/65/EU), REACH, ErP / CoC Tier 2.
- **United Kingdom**: UKCA (Electrical Equipment Safety Regulations).
- **Australia & New Zealand**: RCM (AS/NZS 62368.1), SAA approval.
- **East Asia**: PSE (Japan Electrical Appliance and Material Safety Law, Diamond & Circle), KC (Korea Certification, K62368-1), CCC (China Compulsory Certification, GB 4943.1).
- **International**: CB Scheme (IEC 62368-1, IEC 61558-1/2-16).
